mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster SET total_record_count=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.total} END,channel_distribution=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN CAST(#{row.distributionJson} AS JSON) END,statistics_version=statistics_version+1,statistics_reconciled_at=NOW(3),search_index_status='PENDING',vector_index_status='PENDING',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{row.clusterId}

UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status='ARCHIVED',lifecycle_version=lifecycle_version+1,status_changed_at=NOW(3),status_reason='来源导入批次回滚后无有效反馈',search_index_status='PENDING',vector_index_status='PENDING',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{id} AND cluster_status='ACTIVE'
